Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two men, one an African psychologist and the other a Hispanic construction worker, were both house hunting with their families. The African psychologist's family is having a much harder time than the other family because they are using Section 8 vouchers to help pay for their housing instead of just going through the bank. Which family can buy a home without government assistance?
A. The African psychologist's family
B. The Hispanic construction worker's family
C. Can't answer
